task: 8. Implement TPM2-first keys with explicit secure fallback status
method: cargo test -p namtor-store --lib (downgrade refusal + PCR mismatch tests) + cargo test -p namtor-daemon --lib manager:: (error mapping)

failure_modes.description: Existing storage sealed by a TPM2-type backend (mock-tpm) cannot be opened by a file-only selector. Must return StoreError::DowngradeRefused, not silently fall back to software.
Blob with real 'tpm2' backend_id (wire format from Tpm2Backend) loaded without tpm2 feature or device. Must return DowngradeRefused, not Crypto('unknown backend').
File-backend blob reloads with any selector without triggering DowngradeRefused (file backend is always available).
Key sealed with PCR boot_state binding fails to unseal after a simulated reboot changes PCR 0. Returns Tpm2 error with 'PCR policy mismatch'.
Key sealed with PCR boot_state binding fails to unseal after PCR 7 is changed. Returns Tpm2 error with 'PCR policy mismatch'.
StoreError::DowngradeRefused maps to ApiError::State with 'downgrade refused' prefix for the D-Bus surface.

downgrade_refusal_logic: In SealedKey::load_or_create_with, when an existing blob's backend_id is a TPM2-type (tpm2 or mock-tpm) and selector.open(backend_id) fails, return StoreError::DowngradeRefused with the backend id and original error. File-backend blobs always open (no refusal).
tpm2_type_detection: is_tpm2_type_backend(backend_id) returns true for 'tpm2' (TPM2_BACKEND_ID) and 'mock-tpm' (MockTpm::BACKEND_ID); false for 'file' (FileBackend::BACKEND_ID).
